description: One February search-service response was not persisted; its exact prompt/result are unavailable in the dossier, are not counted in search_log.jsonl, and were not repeated. See audits/capture_loss_001.json.

LibyaReview's Feb 6 article reports “dozens” at a Tripoli healthcare demonstration, but this term does not establish at least 50 simultaneous participants. No exact attendance appears in the opened body.

The Misrata airport union sit-in is reported to start Feb 5 and affect airline operations, with wage/Ministry demands, but no participant number or public accessibility details. Do not infer threshold from operational effects or pool separate airports. Article provides no physical end date.

Search-only Libya Observer Feb 7 report says ground-services workers at Misrata and Sabha resumed after strike. It does not report public gathering/turnout; distinct sites cannot be pooled. Retained as a follow-up lead only.
Historical source ledgers and full independent newspaper/archive access are absent; current receipts/manual assessments do not establish a clean historical inventory or exhaustive coverage.
Official Mass Mobilization baseline/version, licensing and independent review remain pending; candidates are not official rows.

No Jan/Mar continuation is established for the medical demonstration. Ground-services search-only follow-up indicates return to work by Feb 7, but no body is opened for that separate story and same-site event boundaries remain unresolved.
